chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb, from Sa'id al-Samman who said: I was in the presence of

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), when two men from the Zaydiites came to him. They said: 'Is there among you an Imam whose obedience is obligatory?' He said: 'No.' The narrator then said they claimed: 'The trustworthy ones have informed us from you that you issue fatwas, acknowledge it and speak accordingly, and we can name them to you — so-and-so and so-and-so — they are people of piety and diligence, from among those who do not lie.' Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) became angry and said: 'I did not command them to this!' When they saw the anger in his face, they went out. He said to me: 'Do you know these two?' I said: 'Yes, they are both from the people of our market, from the Zaydiites, and they allege that the sword of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) is with Abdullah ibn al-Hasan.' He said: 'They lied — may Allah curse them! By Allah, Abdullah ibn al-Hasan has not seen it with his two eyes, not with one of his eyes, nor has his father seen it — O Allah! — unless he saw it with Ali ibn al-Husain (peace be upon him). If they were truthful, what is the mark on its hilt? And what is the trace at its striking-place? Indeed with me is the sword of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and with me is the banner of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), his armour, his equipment and his helmet. If they were truthful, what

is the mark on the armour of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)? And with me is the victorious banner of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and with me are the Tablets of Moses and his Staff, and with me is the ring of Solomon son of David (peace be upon them both), and with me is the basin in which Moses (peace be upon him) used to offer the sacrifice. And with me is the Name which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), whenever he placed it between the Muslims and the polytheists, no arrow would reach from the polytheists to the Muslims. And with me is the like of what the angels brought, and the example of the weapons among us is like the example of the Ark among the Children of Israel. The Children of Israel were such that

whichever household the Ark was found to be upon their doors was given prophethood, and whoever from us the weapons come to is given the Imamate. My father wore the armour of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and it trailed on the ground, and I wore it and it was (too large), and our Qa'im is he who when he wears it, it will fill him — if Allah wills.

key_terms.التَّابُوت: The Ark — the Ark of the Covenant in Israelite tradition, used as an analogy for the Imami weapons
key_terms.الثِّقَاتُ: The trustworthy ones — reliable transmitters or companions
key_terms.الزَّيْدِيَّةِ: The Zaydiites — followers of Zayd ibn Ali, who held that any descendant of Fatima who rose in armed revolt could be Imam
key_terms.السِّلَاح: The weapons/arms — here referring specifically to the sacred relics inherited by the Imams as signs of authority
key_terms.الْقَائِم: The Qa'im — the rising/standing one, referring to the awaited Imam al-Mahdi
key_terms.الْمِغْلَبَة: The victorious (banner) — a title for the Prophet's standard that brought victory in battle
key_terms.مُفْتَرَضُ الطَّاعَةِ: Imam whose obedience is obligatory — a theological term used in Shia discourse to denote the divinely-appointed Imam

ai.seo_question: What sacred relics and prophetic weapons does Imam al-Sadiq claim to possess as proof of his Imamate?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) responds to two Zaydi visitors who challenged him about claiming the Imamate, by asserting that he possesses the sacred relics of the Prophet (swords, armour, banner) as well as divine artifacts from earlier prophets (Moses's tablets and staff, Solomon's ring), and establishes that possession of the prophetic weapons is a sign of legitimate Imamate — just as possession of the Ark was the sign of prophethood among the Children of Israel. He concludes by prophesying that the Qa'im (the twelfth Imam) will be the one whose body perfectly fills the Prophet's armour.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, from Saeed Al Samman who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> when two men from the Zaydiites came over to him<sup>asws</sup>. So they said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Is there an Imam<sup>asws</sup> among you the obedience to whom is Obligatory?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’. So they said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The reliable ones have informed us from you<sup>asws</sup> that you<sup>asws</sup> tend to issue Fatwas, and are acknowledging as such and are saying with it, and we can name them to you, so and so, and so and so, and they are companions of piety and alertness, and they are from the ones who cannot be belied’. 
So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> got angered and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> did not order them with this!’. So when they saw the anger in his<sup>asws</sup> face, they went out. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Do you know these two?’ I said, ‘Yes, they are both from the people of our market, and they are both from the Zaydiites, and they both allege that the sword of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> is with Abdullah Bin Al-Hassan’. 
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are both lying! May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse them! Abdullah Bin Al-Hassan has not seen it with his two eyes, nor with one of his eyes, nor has his father seen it , O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, except if he happened to have seen it with Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>. So if these two were truthful, so what is the mark in its sheath? And what is trace in its blade? And with me<sup>asws</sup> is the sword of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and with me<sup>asws</sup> is the flag of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and his<sup>saww</sup> armour, and his<sup>saww</sup> insignia, and his<sup>saww</sup> helmet.

So if they were truthful, so what is the mark in the armour of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and with me<sup>asws</sup> is the flag of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, the victorious, and with me<sup>asws</sup> are the Tablets of Musa<sup>as</sup> and his<sup>as</sup> Staff, and with me<sup>asws</sup> is the ring of Suleyman<sup>as</sup> Bin Dawood<sup>as</sup>, and with me<sup>asws</sup> is the tray in which Musa<sup>as</sup> used to offer the sacrificial offering with it.
And with me<sup>asws</sup> is the Name which Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, whenever he<sup>saww</sup> placed it between the Muslims and the Polytheists, no arrow arrived from the Polytheists to the Muslims, and with me<sup>asws</sup> are the remnants which the Angels came with, and the examples of the weapons with us<sup>asws</sup> is like an example of the Ark among the Children of Israel.

The Children of Israel were such that whichever family the Ark was found to be upon their door, were Given the Prophet-hood, and the ones from us<sup>asws</sup> to whom the weapons come to be, is Given the Imamate. My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> had worn the armour of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, so it made lines upon the ground, and I<sup>asws</sup> wore it, so it was and it was (big), and our<sup>asws</sup> Qaim<sup>asws</sup> is the one when he<sup>asws</sup> wears it, it would fit (perfectly), if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires it’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Mu’awiya ibn Wahab from Sa‘id al-Samman who has said the following. “I was in the presence of

abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) when two people from the Zaydia sect came to him. They asked, “Is there with you an Imam obedience to whom is obligatory?” The narrator has said that the Imams (a.s.) said, “No, there no one as suCh” They then said, “Reliable people have informed us about you that you issue fatwas and that you affirm and speak of it. We can point out what their names are. They are very pious alert people. They are such that can not be rejected. The Imams (a.s.) became angry and said, “I have not ordered them to say so.” When the two men notice anger from the face of The Imams (a.s.) they left.” The Imams (a.s.) then asked me, “Do you know these two?” I said, “Yes, I know them. They are from our Suq (shopping center). They belong to the Zaydia sect and they think that the sword of the Holy Prophet (s.a.) is with ‘Abdallah ibn al-Hassan.” The Imams (a.s.) said, “They have lied, may Allah condemn them. I swear by Allah, ‘Abdallah ibn al-Hassan has not seen it with his own eyes, not even of his eyes has seen it. Even his father had seen it except if he might have seen it with Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.). If they are truthful let them say what kind of mark does its hilt have and what is the mark on its blade? With me is the sword of the Messenger of Allah, with me is the flag of the Messenger, his coat of arms, his Lamam (pennon) and his helmet. If they are truthful let them say what kind of mark does the coat of arms of the Messenger of Allah has? With me is the flag of the Messenger of Allah, the victorious. With me is the Staff of Moses. With me is the ring of Solomon son of David. With me is tray on Moses used to offer offerings. With me is the name that whenever the Messenger of Allah would place it between the Muslims and pagans no arrow from the pagans would reach the Muslims. With me is the similar object that angels brought.” Perhaps The Imams (a.s.) has hinted to the following verse. ‘Their Prophet further told them, “As the evidence of his authority, he will bring to you the Ark which will be a comfort to you from your Lord and a legacy of the household of Moses and Aaron. It will be carried by the angels. This is the evidence for you if you have faith.’ [2:248] The case of the Arms with us is like the case of the Ark in the Israelites. Whichever family would have had the Ark at their door-front that family would receive prophet-hood. To whoever of us the Arms are transferred he receives Imamat (leadership with Divine authority). My father wore the coats of arms of the Messenger of Allah. It would reach the earth and leave marks. I wore it also and it reached the earth and sometimes it would not. When the one from us who, will rise to establish the authority of Allah on earth, will come it will fit him perfectly, if Allah would so will.”
